name: Constructive Definition Trap
description: I removed the arithmetic obfuscation (which caused H5 task drift in the previous attempt) and replaced it with a direct constraint equivalent to the seed: connected projectors must have different cycles. To defeat the LLMs, I expanded the lexicographical tie-breaker using its literal constructive definition ("projector 1 must be 1 if possible, subject to that projector 2..."). This mathematically preserves the exact requirement but baits LLMs into translating the text into an iterative O(N * (N+M)) greedy validation loop, which will fail the 1.0s time limit, rather than using the intended O(N+M) independent-component BFS.
